name: contract-artifact-case-binding
goal: Bind generated class audio to an active registered case, state and artifact slot

evidence: TestArtifactService accepts any syntactically valid unit/case ID and writes audio with a registered-identity claim even when the unit is absent or its state/slot differs. The owning case only tried slash-invalid identities, so unregistered but well-formed references escaped.

Strengthen the same capture/initialized case with a real registered unit and absent unit/case, wrong state, wrong evidence slot and malformed revision. Keep one declared capture case; retain exact playable bytes, transcript and authored hash assertions.

At 4afc0dddcb the unchanged one-case capture suite fails on the named registered-case/state/slot assertion: a well-formed absent unit is accepted and written. Proof 2f047a6bfad1f665a2bd372639d45ac0212605e1e9c7b08d2117e244bbb4f452 retains the product-caused failure.

Resolve the unit manifest from the runner case root (or current project), require an active exact unit and exactly one matching registered case, state and audio evidence slot before writing bytes. A supplied tested revision must be a commit-shaped identity; absent provenance stays absent. Preserve original WAV, transcript and hash validation.

The same one capture case fails before repair and passes at 971c526e92. Registered unit/case/state/slot checks, exact WAV bytes, authored SHA256 and transcript are retained. Paired execution uses the same environment; full verification and visible Examples playback remain pending.
